## Objectives

1. Defeat 60 Sprite of Shimmerwaters ([Water Sprite](../monsters/water_sprite.md), [Forest Sprite](../monsters/forest_sprite.md))
2. Reach the way to the Lakehead in [Shimmerwater, the Third Path](../maps/shimmerwater_path_3.md)

- 6,002 EXP
- 780 mesos
- +60 standing with [Seren](../npcs/seren_warden.md)
- +25 standing with Fairy Forest
- Unlocks `boss.blightstone`
